body: Observed 2026-10-12 in /Users/russelllewis/projects/VanillaTwisted using Core1.0.0-rc.3 build456 on macOS. Command: corvint query --task "Production email, push provider delivery, and deployment qualification: runbooks, gates, credentials and access" --limit1 (actual invocation used --limit 1). Exit2: code unsupported-query-authority, error "native Go authority-start query requires one uniquely highest-ranked root AGENTS.md". AGENTS.md exists as symlink to canonical CLAUDE.md. Expected: supported repository context or an actionable explicit capability/prerequisite boundary; actual: authority refusal, requiring direct live runbook fallback. This is confirmed consumer friction; intended profile support and underlying cause are unqualified, not a confirmed product/security bug. Reproduction/error evidence: /Users/russelllewis/projects/VanillaTwisted/.agent-evidence/production-qualification/query-unsupported-receipt.json. Dedup searches: exact error code, uniquely highest, native query had no matches; broad AGENTS.md hits did not establish this case. Separate sandbox descendant-snapshot denial is existing V1-0568 and succeeds with authorized outside-sandbox version checks, not a second new ticket.
title: Clarify authority-start query abstention for a production task with a canonical root-guide symlink
